07 — FAQ

Questions customers ask us every week.

How much does it cost to rent a crane? +

It depends on the load, height, site access and how long you need the crane. Tell us the load weight, location and date — call 0803 347 8167 or fill the quote form — and we will give you a clear quote before you commit. No hidden charges.

How fast can you come to my site? +

We are based in Abule-Egba, close to Abeokuta Expressway, so we mobilise fast across Lagos and Ogun. For same-day jobs, call early on WhatsApp with your location and load details and we will confirm availability the same day.

Do you provide the operator, or only the crane? +

We provide crane + experienced operator as standard. You do not need to find your own operator. Our operator works with your site team and handles positioning and lifting safely.

What areas do you cover? +

We cover Lagos and Ogun State from our Abule-Egba base — including construction sites, factories, warehouses, estates and outdoor advertising sites. If your site is outside these areas, call us and we will confirm if we can mobilise to you.

What do you need from me to give a quote? +

Four things: 1) What to lift and roughly how heavy, 2) Site location, 3) Date you need it, 4) Photos or video of the load and site if you have them. Send them on WhatsApp to 0803 347 8167 and we will quote fast.
